title: Modular security packets & adaptive insurance SLAs for vendor procurement
creator: Priya Menon
description: Goal: Reduce enterprise procurement friction by shipping a set of modular security packets (answers + artifacts) and a standardized insurance negotiation playbook, then measure how bundling these into pricing tiers impacts sales cycle time and win rate. Deliverables: 1) Three modular security packet variants (Basic: SOC2-lite checklist + encryption summary; Standard: SOC2 Type II summary + SOC audit report template; Enterprise: full SOC2 package + penetration test attestation). 2) Adaptive insurance SLA templates (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with sample policy language and suggested premium offsets for hosted vs private deployments. 3) Vendor portal integration spec for one-click packet selection and secure artifact upload. 4) Pricing/packaging experiment plan that offers insurance credits and faster onboarding as tiered incentives. Metrics: onboarding time, contract cycle time, legal review loops, conversion delta across cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence: security packet templates and insurance playbook published and versioned
Vendor portal wireframes + API contract documented and handed to ENG
Pricing experiment cohorts (control + 2 variants) defined and experiment launched with analytics tracking
Target: reduce doc-exchange time by >=40% and shorten contract cycle by >=10% in variant cohorts
